cover.calloutLabel: A note from CEO of Vivo Performing Arts
cover.pressQuote: Every time I see him play, I feel like I'm witnessing a miracle. Fernando Trueba, director of the documentary Calle 54

sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: Berklee Honorary Doctorate recipient Michel Camilo is a musical firestorm of heart, joy, and liveliness—making his Vivo Performing Arts debut with bassist Ricky Rodríguez and drummer Mark Walker in a performance you experience with your whole body.
body: MICHEL CAMILO piano RICKY RODRÍGUEZ bass MARK WALKER drums Michel Camilo, Berklee College of Music's Honorary Doctorate in Music recipient, is a musical firestorm of heart, joy, and liveliness who brings a scintillating light into any space in which he performs. Bassist Ricky Rodríguez and drummer Mark Walker—bound to Camilo by years of hard-won musical trust—keep the pulse that turns his flights of virtuosity into something you experience with your whole body. Come feel it for yourself when the Michel Camilo Trio makes its Vivo Performing Arts debut.

body: Vivo Performing Arts gathers and performs on the unceded ancestral lands of the Massachusett, Pawtucket, and Wampanoag peoples.
Assistive listening devices are available. For ASL or audio description on selected performances, contact access@vivoperformingarts.org at least one week in advance.
